receipt_protocol: QUALITY criterion 19 / R66-D3 fix, kept from round 67: every r68 counter requires --lands <40hex>; the receipt records the stamped revision (--lands), the evaluated revision (`git rev-parse main` of --root), the measured revision (same run), the lands tree hash and the counter's sha256; leg STAMP fails unless evaluated == stamped. Evaluations run inside a materialized clone at the lands commit (`git clone --no-local`), never on a worktree that may have moved past the stamp. Carrier-parentage is post-records evidence (check-receipt-seq.py --topo, committed as reports/round-68/telemetry/post-records.txt), never a lands-time leg. The declared command is `--root <clone> --lands <lands>`; the pre-landing dry run materializes BASE and runs `--lands <base>`, and every base control must FAIL (do-nothing control).

claims.revision_note: Pre-data revision (round-58 precedent; no counter has scored r68 data at revision time). Rev-0 D2 demanded a W04-free census ('census validates with 0 W04 lines'). That state is false at every lands state inside the frozen settlement model: the census prints W04 per URL group equal to distinct_scopes-1, independent of statuses and row order, and at least one flagged pair (S094/S132) is both-rejected and both-immutable with two scopes. An out-of-model evasion (indenting flagged rows 4+ spaces, hiding them from the census) can clear W04 lines; rev-1 D2 fails exactly that state. Proof and empirical confirmation: reports/round-68/telemetry/w04-impossibility.txt; attacks: .ufo/waves/round-68/w1/CriticAmendD2.md. Rev-1 D2 (critic-hardened): census exit 0 at lands; the census W04 URL multiset at lands equals the multiset measured at BASE (no new cross-scope duplicate URLs from round rows, none hidden by evasion; URLs not printed ids, so permitted row reordering cannot fail a true claim; the base registry is staged under <root>/corpus because the census resolves used-by paths from dirname(file)/..); and a valid ledger ruling for every flagged id plus every DEDUP/chain id. Also folded in pre-data (CriticAmendD2 finding 3): the R68 leg's row parse matched only the | S### | prefix (1 cell, 34/34 chains skipped) - it now matches the full row line, so queued/ruling consistency is actually measured. The frozen W04_FLAGGED set also drifted: it names S200, which the census does not flag (empirical 28-id set recorded in accept-ca.py W04_BASE).
